# pbn

# pbn

pbn (“paint by numbers”) holds the house layout of an analysis project,
the checks of that layout, and a few shared helpers. It is the one
policy package of the family. `org` (paths), `cohort` (exclusions) and
`plnr` (plans) are mechanism packages without opinions.

This is a trial version. It holds the smallest set of functions that one
real project can use.

## Installation

``` r
pak::pak("raubreywhite/pbn")
```

## The house layout

All names are lower case. The version is a prefix.

    v01_run.R                 the run script; first call is pbn::initialize_project(version = "v01", ...)
    v01_functions/            sourced folder; holds _cfg.R (top-level `CFG <- list(...)`) and project functions
    v01_results/results.qs2   the results object
    v01_results/scenario/<name>/  the results of a run with data_raw=<path>; <name> is the basename of the normalised path
    v01_test/                 optional testthat files for project functions
    v01_check_functions.R  v01_check_scenarios.R   optional checks of the functions and of scenario runs
    check_project.R           one line: pbn::check_project()
    pbn_allow.txt             optional exceptions to check_project()
    manuscript/manual/vNN_<initials>.docx   hand-edited Word files (initials upper case, e.g. v16_SA.docx)
    manuscript/built/vNN/     pipeline output
    background/  adhoc/  data_describe/
    README.md  CHANGELOG.md  AGENTS.md  .gitignore

## Quick start

`v01_run.R`:

``` r
p <- pbn::initialize_project(version = "v01", home = ".", data_raw = "/data/raw")
d <- data.table::fread(file.path(p$data_raw, "d.csv"))
pbn::save_results(
  exclusions = data.frame(step = "all", n_before = nrow(d), n_excluded = 0, n_after = nrow(d)),
  estimates = data.frame(term = "n", estimate = nrow(d)),
  tables = list(table1 = pbn::table1(d, by = "group", vars = CFG$vars)),
  d = d
)
```

Run it in a new R session, once with a different data folder:

``` r
pbn::run_version("v01")
pbn::run_version("v01", data_raw = "/data/test")
```

The second run writes to `v01_results/scenario/test/`. It does not
change `v01_results/results.qs2`. A scenario run stops when its data
folder is the default data folder, or is or holds `v01_results/`. It
also stops when the scenario folder holds the results of another data
folder with the same basename.
[`?initialize_project`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/initialize_project.md)
lists every stop.

## The seven functions

| Function | What it does |
|----|----|
| [`initialize_project()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/initialize_project.md) | Starts one version with the house defaults of `org`, and sources `vNN_functions/`. |
| [`run_version()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/run_version.md) | Runs `vNN_run.R` in a new R session, optionally with `data_raw=<path>`. |
| [`save_results()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/save_results.md) | Writes `vNN_results/results.qs2` with a manifest, and stops when the object fails the contract. |
| [`read_results()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/read_results.md) | Reads `vNN_results/results.qs2`. |
| [`check_results()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/check_results.md) | Checks a results object against the contract. |
| [`check_project()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/check_project.md) | Checks a project folder against the house layout, and quits with status 1 on a failure when R is not interactive. |
| [`table1()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/table1.md) | Computes the numbers of a descriptive table, with chi-square or Fisher’s exact p-values. |

The help page of each function holds its rules. Start with
[`?check_project`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/check_project.md)
and
[`?save_results`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/save_results.md).

# Package index

## Run a project version

- [`initialize_project()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/initialize_project.md)
  : Start one version of an analysis project
- [`run_version()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/run_version.md)
  : Run one version of a project in a new R session

## Results

- [`save_results()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/save_results.md)
  : Save the results object of a project version
- [`read_results()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/read_results.md)
  : Read the results object of a project version
- [`check_results()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/check_results.md)
  : Check a results object against the contract

## Checks of the layout

- [`check_project()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/check_project.md)
  : Check a project against the house layout

## Shared helpers

- [`table1()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/table1.md) : Compute
  the numbers of a descriptive table
